topics.title: Number bases/Modular Arithmetic
items: (a) operations in different number bases from 2 to 10
(b) conversion from one base to another including fractional parts
objectives: i. perform four basic operations (x,+,-,÷)
ii. convert one base to another
iii. perform operations in modulo arithmetic

topics.title: Fractions, Decimals, Approximations
objectives: i. perform basic operations (x,+,-,÷) on fractions and decimals
ii. express to specified number of significant figures and decimal places
iii. calculate simple interest, profit and loss per cent; ratio proportion, rate and percentage error
iv. solve problems involving share and VAT

topics.title: Indices, Logarithms and Surds
items: (e) logarithm of any positive number to a given base
(f) change of bases in logarithm and application
objectives: i. apply the laws of indices in calculation
ii. establish the relationship between indices and logarithms in solving problems
iii. solve equations involving indices
iv. solve problems in different bases in logarithms
v. simplify and rationalize surds
vi. perform basic operations on surds

topics.title: Sets
items: (c) Venn diagrams and their applications. iv. v
objectives: i. identify types of sets, i.e. empty, universal, complements, subsets, finite, infinite and disjoint sets
ii. solve problems involving cardinality of sets
iii. solve set problems using symbols
iv. use Venn diagrams to solve problems involving not more than 3 sets

topics.title: Polynomials
items: (b) addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of polynomials
(c) factorization of polynomials of degree not exceeding 3
(d) roots of polynomials not exceeding degree 3
(f) simultaneous equations including one linear one quadratic
(g) graphs of polynomials of degree not greater than 3
objectives: i. find the subject of the formula of a given equation
ii. apply factor and remainder theorem to factorize a given expression
iii. multiply, divide polynomials of degree not more than 3 and determine values of defined and undefined expression
iv. factorize by regrouping difference of two squares, perfect squares and cubic expressions; etc
v. solve simultaneous equations – one linear, one quadratic
vi. interpret graphs of polynomials including applications to maximum and minimum values

topics.title: Variation
objectives: i. solve problems involving direct, inverse, joint and partial variations
ii. solve problems on percentage increase and decrease in variation

topics.title: Inequalities
items: (a) analytical and graphical solutions of linear inequalities
(b) quadratic inequalities with integral roots only
objectives: i. solve problems on linear and quadratic inequalities
ii. interpret graphs of inequalities

topics.title: Progression
items: (b) sum of A. P. and G. P
objectives: i. determine the nth term of a progression
ii. compute the sum of A. P. and G.P
iii. sum to infinity of a given G.P

topics.title: Binary Operations
items: (a) properties of closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity
(b) identity and inverse elements (simple cases only)
objectives: i. solve problems involving closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity
ii. solve problems involving identity and inverse elements

topics.title: Matrices and Determinants
items: (a) algebra of matrices not exceeding 3 x 3
(b) determinants of matrices not exceeding 3 x 3
(c) inverses of 2 x 2 matrices; [excluding quadratic and higher degree equations]
objectives: i. perform basic operations (x,+,-,÷) on matrices
ii. calculate determinants
iii. compute inverses of 2 x 2 matrices

topics.title: Euclidean Geometry
items: (b) Polygons: triangles, quadrilaterals and general polygons
(c) Circles: angle properties, cyclic; quadrilaterals and intersecting chords
objectives: i. identify various types of lines and angles
ii. solve problems involving polygons
iii. calculate angles using circle theorems
iv. identify construction procedures of special angles, e.g. 30º, 45º, 60º, 75º, 90º etc

topics.title: Mensuration
items: (a) lengths and areas of plane geometrical figures
(b) lengths of arcs and chords of a circle
(c) Perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles
(d) surface areas and volumes of simple solids and composite figures
(e) the earth as a sphere: longitudes and latitudes
objectives: i. calculate the perimeters and areas of triangles, quadrilaterals, circles and composite figures
ii. find the length of an arc, a chord, perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles
iii. calculate total surface areas and volumes of cuboids, cylinders. cones, pyramids, prisms, spheres and composite figures
iv. determine the distance between two points on the earth’s surface

topics.title: Loci
items: locus in 2 dimensions based on geometric principles relating to lines and curves
objectives: identify and interpret loci relating to parallel lines, perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors and circles

topics.title: Coordinate Geometry
items: (a) midpoint and gradient of a line segment
objectives: i. determine the midpoint and gradient of a line segment
ii. find the distance between two points
iii. identify conditions for parallelism and perpendicularity
iv. find the equation of a line in the two-point form, point-slope form, slope intercept form and the general form

topics.title: Trigonometry
objectives: i. calculate the sine, cosine and tangent of angles between - 360º ≤ Ɵ ≤ 360º
ii. apply these special angles, e.g. 30º, 45º, 60º, 75º, 90º, 1050, 135º to solve simple problems in trigonometry
iii. solve problems involving angles of elevation and depression
iv. solve problems involving bearings
v. apply trigonometric formulae to find areas of triangles
vi. solve problems involving sine and cosine graphs

topics.title: Application of differentiation
objectives: solve problems involving applications of rate of change, maxima and minima

topics.title: Integration
items: (a) integration of explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions
objectives: i. solve problems of integration involving algebraic and simple trigonometric functions
ii. calculate area under the curve (simple cases only)

topics.title: Representation of data
items: (b) histogram, bar chart and pie chart
objectives: i. identify and interpret frequency distribution tables
ii. interpret information on histogram, bar chat and pie chart

topics.title: Measures of Location
items: (a) mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data – (simple cases only)
objectives: i. calculate the mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data (simple cases only)
ii. use Ogive to find the median, quartiles and percentiles

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion
items: range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation
objectives: calculate the range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation of ungrouped and grouped data

topics.title: Permutation and Combination
objectives: solve simple problems involving permutation and combination

topics.title: Probability
items: (a) experimental probability (tossing of coin, throwing of a dice etc)
(b) Addition and multiplication of probabilities (mutual and independent cases)
objectives: solve simple problems in probability (including addition and multiplication)
